title: [29.X]-FA Posting Group is not updated in the Fixed Asset List after being changed on the Fixed Asset Card
summary: Fixed Asset posting group changes made on the Fixed Asset Card now refresh properly in the Fixed Asset List view.
key_points: FA posting group updates on the card are now reflected in the list
Added refresh trigger on the Fixed Asset Card page
Applied consistently across multiple localization layers (AT, FR, IT, NA, RU, W1)
Resolves synchronization issue between card and list views
